name: Google Gemini on Vertex AI and the Gemini API
notes: Flag only. map_automatically is false on every model and every platform schedule, and there are no rules, so fix and swap leave these IDs alone. The Gemini API auto-route is a silent tier change, so this pack does not rewrite the ID.

Vertex detection is file-level, using the signal id 'vertex'. For a model with platforms, the entry whose when_any includes vertex wins when that signal is in the same file. High risk when that schedule's shutdown is within urgent_days or already past. A Vertex import in a different file does not count.

With no vertex signal, gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash use the Gemini API schedule (shutdown 2026-12-01, separate replacements). That date raises risk the same way. gemini-2.5-flash-lite and gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio have no Gemini API shutdown in this pack, so a file without the vertex signal stays informational.

Checked https://cloud.google.com/vertex-ai/generative-ai/docs/learn/model-versions on 16 Oct 2026. That URL redirects to the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform model-versions page. The lifecycle table lists gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite with retirement date 20 Oct 2026. It lists no -001, dated, or preview ID for these three. gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio retires 13 Dec 2026 with no replacement model ID in that cell. gemini-2.5-flash-image retires 15 Mar 2027; the replacement cell is gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image.

Checked https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/deprecations on 4 Nov 2026. gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash are removed from AI Studio selection. The API still accepts them until 1 Dec 2026, then automatically routes pro to gemini-3.8-flash (billed at Gemini 3.8 Flash rates) and flash to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (billed at Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates). gemini-2.5-flash-lite has no shutdown date announced. The same page lists gemini-2.5-flash-image shutting down on 15 Mar 2027, replacement gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image. Preview IDs (for example gemini-2.5-pro-preview-06-05) are different models with their own, already passed, shutdowns and are not these rows.

Suggested Vertex replacement is the first model ID in Google's 'or' list. The other listed options are in each model's note. Gemma 4 is named for gemini-2.5-flash-lite but the page does not give it a model ID.

risk_policy.otherwise_note: retires on Vertex AI; not deprecated on the Gemini API

confirmed: On Vertex AI, gemini-2.5-pro (released 17 Jun 2025), gemini-2.5-flash (released 17 Jun 2025) and gemini-2.5-flash-lite (released 22 Jul 2025) retired on 20 Oct 2026.

Documented Vertex replacements: gemini-2.5-pro -> gemini-3.8-flash or gemini-3.5-flash; gemini-2.5-flash -> gemini-3.8-flash or gemini-3.5-flash-lite or gemini-3.1-flash-lite; gemini-2.5-flash-lite -> gemini-3.8-flash or gemini-3.1-flash-lite or Gemma 4.
The model versions table does not list a -001, dated, or preview ID for these three stable models.

On the Gemini API, checked 4 Nov 2026, gemini-2.5-pro shuts down on 1 Dec 2026 and automatically routes to gemini-3.8-flash (Gemini 3.8 Flash rates). gemini-2.5-flash shuts down on the same date and automatically routes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite (Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite rates). Both are already removed from AI Studio selection. gemini-2.5-flash-lite has no shutdown date announced.

On Vertex AI, gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio (released 12 Dec 2025) retires on 13 Dec 2026. The model versions table's replacement cell for that row is empty. That ID is not a Gemini API deprecations row.
gemini-2.5-flash-image (released 2 Oct 2025) shuts down on 15 Mar 2027 on Vertex AI and on the Gemini API. Both pages list gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image as the replacement.
unconfirmed: No live API calls were made. Replacements were not checked for parameter compatibility, so this pack does not swap or rewrite calls.

next_steps: If the call uses Vertex AI, gemini-2.5-pro, gemini-2.5-flash and gemini-2.5-flash-lite already retired on 20 Oct 2026. Point the call at the suggested replacement and test it. This pack only flags the ID; it does not rewrite code.

If the call uses the Gemini API, gemini-2.5-pro automatically routes to gemini-3.8-flash on 1 Dec 2026 and gemini-2.5-flash automatically routes to gemini-3.5-flash-lite on that date. gemini-2.5-flash-lite has no shutdown date on the Gemini API. This pack does not rewrite these IDs.

gemini-2.5-flash-image shuts down on 15 Mar 2027 on both Vertex AI and the Gemini API; the listed replacement is gemini-3.1-flash-lite-image. gemini-live-2.5-flash-native-audio is a Vertex retirement on 13 Dec 2026 with no replacement model ID on the model versions page.
